about: The crop maps that say where a crop grows (E163): the weights by which an origin's weather is averaged over the crop's own harvested area. Each crop of the registry names its map and layers (crop_registry.json: crop_map); a cell's area is given to the ERA5-Land 0.1° cell that contains its centre, and to the country (GISCO 2020 countries, 1:3 million) whose polygon contains its centre.

mapspam2020.source: IFPRI MapSPAM 2020 V2r2 — global harvested area per crop, all technologies (Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/SWPENT), CC BY 4.0

cropgrids108.source: CROPGRIDS v1.08 (Tang et al. 2024, figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.22491997) — harvested area per crop, 2020, CC BY 4.0

countries.source: Eurostat GISCO — countries 2020, 1:3 million (data/reference/geo/countries_world_03m_2020.geojson.gz); CNTR_ID, with Eurostat's EL and UK read as GR and GB

era5_grid: ERA5-Land 0.1°: latitude 90 → -90 (1801 rows), longitude 0 → 359.9 (3600 columns); a crop-map cell goes to the ERA5 cell whose centre is nearest its own centre
